verdict.rationale: WooCommerce provides a documented REST/Store API with official JS, PHP, Python, and Ruby libraries, a WC-CLI for command-line management, theme/plugin hook system (add_action) for extending core templates, and a Marketplace for distributing free/paid extensions — covering much of the extensibility story. However, there is no explicit scaffolding tool (e.g., a generator/boilerplate CLI for new extensions) and no documented extension review/approval process for marketplace submission. missing for 10: dedicated scaffolding/boilerplate tooling for new extensions, documented marketplace review/approval criteria and distribution policy.
